name: Batch API (developer tools)
description: Developer tools for utilizing Drupal's Batch API: OO operation base classes, a batch builder, a finish-operation class, and Drush code generators.
project_description: Batch API provides developer tooling around Drupal's core Batch API. It offers object-oriented operation base classes (EnumeratedOperationBase for a fixed list of items, HighwaterOperationBase for progressively loaded/very large sets), a BatchBuilder that extends core's builder to accept operation objects, a FinishDefault class that can redirect on completion, and two Drush code generators (batch:operation, batch:finish) to scaffold new classes. It has no routes, forms, permissions, or configuration; developers use its classes in their own code. Depends on the Awareness module for entity-type-manager and memory-cache awareness traits.
